```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
# Browser cache key, derived from the database's own bytes.
#
# It used to be the release tag:
#     "vannmiljo-pilot@v0.1.24"
# That was wrong. The database is re-uploaded onto the EXISTING Latest release
# rather than tagged afresh (see docs/websites.md in multised-engine), so the
# tag does not move when the file changes, and every returning visitor went on
# serving the stale database out of browser cache. Hashing the file is exact by
# construction: same bytes, same key; new bytes, new key. The pre-render step
# guarantees the file is here before this runs.
ojs_define(
  dbCacheKey = paste0(
    "vannmiljo-pilot@",
    substr(unname(tools::md5sum("vannmiljo_pilot.sqlite")), 1, 12)
  )
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
db = {
  const StratumSQLite = await window._stratumSQLite;
  return StratumSQLite.open(window._dbPath, {
    sqlJsPath: window._sqljsBase,
    cacheKey:  dbCacheKey,
  });
}

```
